title: Reference triangle
text: As above, the relationship $$\tan(\theta)=x=\frac{x}{1}$$ can be encoded in a right triangle with opposite side length $$x$$ and adjacent side length $$1$$. \n The image below shows a right triangle with a horizontal base labeled $$1$$ and vertical opposite side labeled $$x$$. The diagonal hypotenuse is unlabeled. The acute angle between the base and the hypotenuse is labeled theta.\n##figure2.gif##

title: Find hypotenuse length
text: By the Pythagorean theorem, the hypotenuse length is $$\sqrt{1+x**2}$$
